changelog: POLISH: Hidden the '-debug' suffix from the version badge in the bottom-right corner — the build is still the same proven non-R8 build, just stops showing 'debug' to end users.
FIX: Speed Test screen now fits on smaller TVs. Shrunk the speedometer, tightened spacing, and the whole pane scrolls if your TV has heavy overscan.
FIX: Discovery hero now shows hi-res TMDB backdrops again — bypasses TMDB's broken /trending/* cache via fallback endpoints (movie/popular, tv/on_the_air).
FIX: Parental Controls now actually hide locked categories across Live TV, Movies, Series, and Search.
FIX: Parental Controls PIN now uses an on-screen D-pad keypad (works with any TV remote).
